name: repeat-while-expr-and-times-valid
description: a repeat block carrying both times and an expr condition parses, with a selector-object notVisible nested in an inner repeat.
yaml:
- repeat:
    times: 10
    while:
      expr: attempts < 5
    commands:
      - repeat:
          while:
            notVisible:
              id: spinner
          commands:
            - back
